thread:
pranay: Quick ask — can someone run a small H100 vs L40S micro-bench for the 2k-context path? Need batch=1/4/16, modes=fp16,int8 (our optimized int8 path). Looking for p50/p95/p99 and rough $/token. Trying to repro a customer p99 regression seen in canary. Tag results with PR/commit. Thanks!

alex_m: On it. I'll run on h100-usw2 and l40s-eu. Which model variant? rw-open-70b? Also which workload — completion or chat? I assume completion with sampling.

pranay: completion sampling, temp=0.2, typical seq lengths: prompt ~200, gen ~1800. Model: rw-open-70b, commit a1f3b2c (canary). Please include kernel perf counters if you can.

jinah: Add `--trace=kvcache,rospan` to the run to capture KV-cache hit rates. That helped last time.

alex_m: Command I'll use:
```bash
./scripts/run_bench.sh \
  --model rw-open-70b --commit a1f3b2c \
  --ctx 2048 --batch '1,4,16' --modes 'fp16,int8' \
  --temp 0.2 --trace 'kvcache,rospan' \
  --out /tmp/bench-182345
```
Posting once runs finish.

bench-bot: Queued bench on h100-usw2 (slot: g1). Estimated runtime ~35m.

samir: Please also tag the run with `canary-p99-investigation` and include `--run-metadata pr=hd/3092` so the dashboard links to the PR.

alex_m: Added tag, starting h100 fp16 now.

bench-bot: h100 fp16 batch=1 p50=88ms p95=140ms p99=260ms throughput=12 toks/s cost_tok=$0.000011
h100 int8 batch=1 p50=75ms p95=125ms p99=230ms throughput=14 toks/s cost_tok=$0.000009
(Lines abbreviated — full logs uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/182345/h100_fp16.log, s3://redwood-bench/182345/h100_int8.log)

bench-bot: l40s fp16 batch=1 p50=95ms p95=165ms p99=310ms throughput=10 toks/s cost_tok=$0.000013
l40s int8 batch=1 p50=80ms p95=150ms p99=290ms throughput=11 toks/s cost_tok=$0.000011
(full logs s3://redwood-bench/182345/l40s_fp16.log, s3://redwood-bench/182345/l40s_int8.log)

lisa: Quick note — int8 seems better for single requests on h100, but l40s shows higher tail. Might be driver/driver-level kernel scheduling. Can we check nv-peer metrics and cuda driver versions?

alex_m: nv driver on h100-usw2 = 535.86, l40s-eu = 535.54. I'll re-run with pinned driver=535.86 on a test L40S host.

ops-bot: Reservation check: l40s-eu has 2 nodes available for test, no dedicated reservation conflict.

jinah: Also compare batch=16 numbers — that's where batching improvements should show cost wins.

bench-bot: h100 int8 batch=16 p50=190ms p95=420ms p99=760ms throughput=160 toks/s cost_tok=$0.0000035
l40s int8 batch=16 p50=210ms p95=480ms p99=900ms throughput=140 toks/s cost_tok=$0.0000040

alex_m: Observed: H100 consistently lower p99 across modes. L40S int8 batch16 has higher p99 spike — suspect NUMA or PCI-e gen differences. Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3092

samir: Thanks. Can we add a microprofile of a single p99 event? `perf record`/nsys capture would help.

alex_m: Captured `nsys` on one p99 sample and uploaded `s3://redwood-bench/182345/nsys_h100_p99.qdrep`

bench-bot: All bench artifacts + metadata uploaded. Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.com/bench/182345

pranay: Awesome — this is useful. @alex_m @jinah please add a short note in the canary ticket about probable cause (driver + kernel scheduling) and recommend next steps (driver sync + kernel param tweak). I'll coordinate customer comms.

alex_m: Will add notes and proposed rollback policy in INF-3092.

lisa: FYI I'll schedule a deeper perf sweep next week focusing on PCIe/NUMA pinned runs.

pranay: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
